Name: Hammoleketh
Summary: Sister of Gilead who bore Ishod, Abiezer, and Mahalah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:18: Sister of Gilead who bore Ishod, Abiezer, and Mahalah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Hammoleketh in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
